## Featured Stories & Case Studies (`stories.html`)
URL: https://nugrohoamdalportfolio.dpdns.org/stories.html

### 1. Zero-Cost LMS & Deterministic Automation for 500+ Staff Across 26 Countries
- **Context:** Managing remote operations and cross-border team onboarding across 26 countries without high recurring per-seat SaaS costs.
- **Solution:** Designed and deployed a zero-cost LMS using Google Workspace infrastructure, Google Apps Script, and automated webhooks for TEI Recruitment.
- **Impact:**
  - Managed 100+ international trainees and 5-7 trainers simultaneously.
  - Lifted talent retention rate by +30%.
  - Zero recurring third-party software licensing overhead.

### 2. Mobile Performance Evaluation App (Apple App Store & Google Play Store)
- **Context:** Manual monthly performance evaluations across multiple educational branches took 48 hours to collect, calculate, and compile into leaderboards.
- **Solution:** Developed an internal mobile app published to Google Play Store and Apple App Store for real-time peer and superior appraisals.
- **Impact:**
  - Slashed compilation cycle from 48 hours to 15-30 minutes semi-realtime.
  - Transparent KPIs boosted team trust and accountability.
  - Awarded *Best HR of the Year 2023* (Mr. BOB Kampung Inggris).

### 3. Mentoring 150+ Aviation Cadets at Aeronef Academy & Jogja Flight
- **Context:** Cabin crew recruitment requires impeccable grooming, English fluency under pressure, and flawless behavioral presentation.
- **Solution:** Integrated BNSP Level 4 instructional methodology with rigorous mock interview panels and Aviation English pronunciation drills.
- **Impact:**
  - 150+ cadets successfully prepared for domestic and international airline recruitment drives (Garuda Indonesia, Lion Air Group, Citilink, AirAsia, Emirates, Qatar Airways).

### 4. Scaling Talent Up to 1,000+ Job Seekers & Professionals
- **Context:** Millions of graduates struggle with ATS filters and unstructured interview responses.
- **Solution:** Combined deterministic algorithmic scoring with personalized human feedback through Career Coach AI and intensive cohort bootcamps.
- **Impact:**
  - 1,000+ professionals and fresh graduates coached.
  - Average interview invitation rate increased from 8% to 42% within 30 days post-mentorship.
